title: UFO flying figure eights shoots into mountain without explosion
summary: Robert Bigelow tells of UFO flying figure eights shoots into mountain without explosion, about an unknown time at Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And so they stand there and they're watching this, and then it deviates dramatically, and it shoots off at low altitude right into the mountain itself. But there's no explosion. It's just gone.
